content:
elaine_sales: Quick heads up — CodaHealth wants a 6-week hosted POC. Heavy embeddings use, low gen. They're asking for a temporary 'embeddings-friendly' per-token rate for the pilot and to waive the usual min charge. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

tom_ae: They said they'll sign a PO today if we can give a short-term price break. No infra changes, hosted only.

sara_pricing: Can you share expected token breakdown and total estimated tokens? We need numbers to propose a concrete adjustment.

nick_engineer: Rough estimates from the scoping call: embeddings ~80% of tokens. Expected ~45M embedding tokens over 6 weeks, ~1.2M gen tokens. Embedding batch size ~32, so calls ~=1.4M.

elaine_sales: Exact ask: temporary per-embedding token at $0.00045 for first 50M tokens, then revert to list. They offered to prepay $8k for the pilot. Also asked to waive our standard min charge for pilots.

azadeh_cs: Security note: they're fine with hosted; SQ incoming but nothing unusual flagged. We'll answer standard questions, no VPC.

sara_pricing: Two candidate paths: 
1) Create a timeboxed special tier: $0.00045/embedding-token for first 50M, auto-revert after 6 weeks. Require signed PO + prepay $8k. Needs deal-desk + finance sign-off.
2) Keep list price, accept prepay $8k and classify remainder as a one-time marketing credit to absorb delta. Faster but has different accounting.

tom_ae: They prefer path 1 (explicit lower per-token). Credits won't fly.

sara_pricing: OK. I'll open a formal deal-desk request. @dealbot please create approval request with proposed tier and caps. Need finance + legal review.

dealbot: New approval created: REQ-8342 -> https://redwood.internal/deals/REQ-8342 (includes proposed rates, cap 50M, auto-revert clause).

finance_bot: Flag: prepay $8k will be treated as deferred revenue until delivery; need GL code and billing schedule. If we're doing a price amendment, revenue recognition may change. cc @sara_pricing

sara_pricing: Noted. I'll include revenue recognition note in the request. Legal, will a short amendment template work? Need revert clause and prepay ack.

maria_legal: Yes, we can use the pilot amendment template. Include: start/end dates, token cap, auto-revert to list prices, and statement that prepay is non-refundable and applied to usage. I can draft a one-pager.

nick_engineer: Small ops note: for large embedding batches we'll pin model to gptx-embed-16q and region us-west2; batching limits look good. No infra change needed for a 6-week pilot.

sara_pricing: I can recommend approval to accept path 1 contingent on: PO received, prepay posted, legal amendment executed. Timebox: 6 weeks, 50M cap, auto-revert. I'll escalate to finance for final sign-off.

elaine_sales: I can get PO and prepay today if pricing/finance sign. Will loop in the buyer to sign amendment.

azadeh_cs: I'll stand by for the SQ and provide answers ASAP.

sara_pricing: OK — moving to deal desk. If finance signs off before EOD we can commit. Thanks all.

elaine_sales: Thanks team — will post PO here once it's in.
